pang.definition:
n. a sudden sharp feeling
n. a mental pain or distress
n. a sharp spasm of pain
pang.translation:
n. 剧痛, 悲痛, 苦闷
vt. 使剧痛, 折磨

panga.definition: n a large heavy knife used in Central and South America as a weapon or for cutting vegetation

pangaea.definition: n. (plate tectonics) a hypothetical continent including all the landmass of the earth prior to the Triassic period when it split into Laurasia and Gondwanaland

pangamic acid.translation:
[化] 潘氨酸; 维生素B15
[医] 泛配子酸(维生素B-15)

pangani.translation: (=green ivory)一种质地最优良的象牙(产于非洲东海岸的潘加尼Pangani, 属坦桑尼亚)

pangas.definition:
plural of panga
n a large heavy knife used in Central and South America as a weapon or for cutting vegetation
pangas.translation: (panga 的复数) n. 大砍刀

pangborn test.translation: [医] 潘博恩氏试验(梅毒絮凝反应)

pangborn tests.translation: [医] 潘博恩氏试验(梅毒絮凝反应)

pangea.definition: n (plate tectonics) a hypothetical continent including all the landmass of the earth prior to the Triassic period when it split into Laurasia and Gondwanaland

pangen.translation:
n. 胚芽, 泛生子, 泛子
[医] 胚芽, 胚浆粒, 泛子(生命力最小单位)

pangenesis.definition:
n. An hypothesis advanced by Darwin in explanation of
   heredity.
pangenesis.translation:
n. 机体再生说, 泛生子论, 泛生论
[医] 泛生论

pangenetic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to pangenesis.

pangeodesics.translation: 泛短程线, 泛测地线

pangloss.translation: abbr. Parallel Architecture for Networking Gateways Linking Open Systems Interconnections 连接开放性互连网络的网关所用的并联体制

panglossian.translation:
a. 过分乐观的,认为一切都趋于至善的
n. 过分乐观者

pangolin.definition: n. toothless mammal of southern Africa and Asia having a body covered with horny scales and a long snout for feeding on ants and termites

pangolins.definition:

pangolins.translation: (pangolin 的复数) n. 穿山甲, 鲮鲤
